title: fileparts
summary: Split a path into folder, base filename, and extension.

gpu_support.notes: Host-only lexical parser. Numeric and provider-resident inputs are invalid text and are rejected before gather or provider access.

description: Split a textual path into folder, base filename, and extension without consulting the filesystem. Numeric and integer inputs are inapplicable. RunMat currently implements the scalar character-result subset; documented string-array and cell-array type/shape preservation remains incomplete.
behaviors: Accepts a string scalar, scalar string array, or character row vector.
Runs as a host-only lexical parser and does not require the path to exist.
Nonscalar string arrays, cell arrays of character vectors, type/shape-preserving output, and complete dotfile/trailing-delimiter behavior remain implementation gaps.
